rules: Use attention orange rarely and only from --color-attention.
Chinese mode keeps native Chinese font stacks and removes negative tracking.
Surfaces are flat by default; shadows indicate real layering.
Mobile must not depend on hover for critical information.
Project cards should be evidence-led, not decorative.
Do not fake product screenshots, architecture, or UI previews inside project image areas before real assets exist.
